ownerDecision.request: lets create a polish t64 variannnt and add it too
ownerDecision.scope: One original Polish game concept, the PT-64 Tur, on the true T-64 base of release 262 (profiles/t64Foundation.ts). Poland never fielded the T-64; the Tur is a what-if T-64B1 through the PT-91 Twardy programme.

pt64_tur.silhouette: Polish game concept on the true T-64 hull, six-wheel running gear and cast turret: framed ERAWA-2 Krata grids on the glacis, two welded cheek boxes a side and the leading skirts, Tellur 2 x 12 smoke, Obra-3 heads, a Drawa-T thermal head, the remote 12.7 mm and a rear stowage box
